verifiedClaims: ConceptAs<T> requires T to implement IComparable.
ConceptAs<T> wraps one non-null value and supplies concept-to-T conversion.
Primitive-to-derived-concept conversion is optional and declared by the derived type.
Extra properties are incompatible with the single-value serialization contract.
Enums should not be wrapped as concepts.
EventSourceId<T> requires T to implement IComparable.
Base conversions do not construct an arbitrary derived domain identity.
A typed identity must be supplied to Chronicle operations to select the stream.
CHR0026 rejects Key or Subject on EventSourceId<T>-derived members.
CHR0034 rejects PII event-source identifiers; sensitive natural IDs require a surrogate stream ID.
Typed empty or zero values are specified stream IDs, not EventSourceId.Unspecified.
